descriptions.w3d_cc17d_video_buffer_size_802e10b8: Returns 0 unless the +160 word of the info object at +4 is set; otherwise sums ten 32-byte-aligned copies of the +68 value, the aligned product of +128 and +132, twice the aligned quarter of that product and, when +172 is set, four times the aligned 4*(+72) value, plus 4096.
